title: Optimize mobile card view: visual hierarchy, currency formatting, stage badges
body:
Mobile card view (< 480px) renders all fields as identical flat key-value rows — raw numbers for amounts, ISO strings for dates, plain text for stages. Low information density, no visual hierarchy. ### ObjectGrid card view restructure (`plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`) - **Title row**: First column rendered as `font-semibold` card title instead of a key-value pair - **Amount + Stage row**: Side-by-side compact layout — amount auto-detected by field name pattern and formatted via `formatCurrency()`, stage rendered as `` with semantic color mapping: - green → won/completed/done - red → lost/cancelled/rejected - yellow → negotiation/review/in-progress - blue → proposal/pending - indigo → qualification, purple → prospecting - **Date fields**: Auto-detected and formatted via `formatDate()` (`Jan 15, 2024` vs `2024-01-15T00:00:00.000Z`) - **Skeleton loading**: 3 `animate-pulse` card placeholders when `useCardView && loading` Field classification uses name-pattern matching (`amountKeys`, `stageKeys`, `dateKeys`) to determine rendering strategy per column — no schema changes required. ### CRM example (`examples/crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts`) Stage field options now include `color` metadata for SelectCellRenderer in grid/table views: ```typescript stage: Field.select([ { value: "Prospecting", label: "Prospecting", color: "purple" }, { value: "Closed Won", label: "Closed Won", color: "green" }, { value: "Closed Lost", label: "Closed Lost", color: "red" }, // ... ], { label: 'Stage' }), ``` ### Tests 10 new tests in `mobile-card-view.test.tsx` covering title hierarchy, currency formatting (`$150,000.00`), stage badge colors per variant, date formatting, and card structure. All 125 grid tests pass. ### ROADMAP Added 5 completed items under P6.1 ObjectGrid mobile section.
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > 优化移动端 卡片列表视图展示与交互体验 > 参考以下内容，主要是评估统一控件和组件的修改，包括例子中元素据的修改 > > ## 背景 > 移动端 Opportunity（商机）列表视图目前存在信息密度低、可用性与可读性待提升的问题。主要体现在字段展示方式、格式、交互入口、视觉分层和性能等方面。 > > > > ## 主要问题 > 1. **字段格式未友好显示**：Amount未货币格式化，Close date为原始ISO字符串。 > 2. **卡片内容层级单一**：Name、Amount、Stage、Close date等字段以相同行样式排列，占用空间偏大，主要内容不突出。 > 3. **Stage无颜色区分**：不同阶段仅文本，无视觉标识，辨识度低。 > 4. **缺少卡片快捷操作**：无法实现如滑动出现编辑等交互。 > 5. **底部导航标签被截断**：部分tab名称显示不全。 > 6. **Skeleton 卡片/Loading 无细节**：加载时体验不佳。 > 7. **未实现无缝分页或虚拟列表**：多数据卡顿风险。 > > ## 优化建议 > ### 1. 字段格式优化 & 视觉层级 > - Name 作为卡片title加粗突出 > - Amount 金额货币格式化，如￥150,000 或 $150,000 > - Stage 添加彩色badge（不同状态不同颜色） > - Close date 格式化为短日期(如'2024-01-15') > - Amount和Stage横向并列，提升可读性 > > ### 2. 交互与性能优化 > - 卡片可左右滑动出现常用操作（Edit/Change Stage） > - 加载数据时展示Skeleton卡片动画 > - 支持下拉刷新（已实现）基础上，增加无限滚动加载 > > ### 3. 底部导航优化 > - 标签文本优先全名显示，不足时仅显示图标 > - 使用@object-ui/mobile的MobileOverrides.navigation: 'bottom-tabs'提升体验 > > ## 代码实现参考 > - 重点参考`ObjectGrid`组件（packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx）的移动端card view逻辑 > - 善用@object-ui/mobile中的useBreakpoint/useResponsive等hooks > - 需调整generateColumns、卡片结构与样式细节，实现信息紧凑与主次分明 > > --- > **该优化会显著提升移动端 Opportunity 视图的易用性与美观度，并能有效解决现有主要痛点。** > > > 优化完成后请务必自行运行test并关注相关问题，并及时同步Roadmap。 > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
